privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draft: Working draft, to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch.

sections.p: Data from the enquiry form (name, email, phone, message) and, with your consent, a transcript of your conversation with the AI assistant.
We handle enquiries and keep them for at most 24 months. Stored conversations without an enquiry are deleted after 90 days.
Hosting (Vercel), database (Supabase, EU), AI model (Anthropic), email (Resend).
You may request access, correction, erasure or portability and withdraw consent. Delete a stored conversation with the button in the chat; exercise other rights by email.
